description: Closed-form plus Monte-Carlo projection model quantifying how a purely cytoplasmic protein appears nuclear in imaging flow cytometry of late erythroblasts
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests

# =====================================================================
# Quantitative test of the imaging-artifact alternative.
# Imaging flow cytometry (Amnis) records a WIDEFIELD PROJECTION through the
# whole cell and assigns signal to the "nucleus" by overlap with a nuclear
# (DRAQ5/Hoechst) mask. Model: concentric spheres, cell radius R, nucleus
# radius r, fluorophore uniform in the CYTOPLASMIC SHELL ONLY (zero in nucleus).
# Fraction of total signal that projects inside the nuclear mask disc:
#   F = [R^3 - (R^2-r^2)^{3/2} - r^3] / (R^3 - r^3)        (closed form)
# =====================================================================
def frac_in_mask(q):            # q = r/R
    R=1.0; r=q
    return (R**3 - (R**2-r**2)**1.5 - r**3)/(R**3 - r**3)
def per_area(q):
    F=frac_in_mask(q)
    inside = F/(np.pi*q**2); outside=(1-F)/(np.pi*(1-q**2))
    return inside, outside, inside/outside

# numerical check of the closed form by direct 3-D integration
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
for qtest in [0.5,0.78,0.9]:
    n=2_000_000
    p=rng.uniform(-1,1,(n,3)); rr=np.sqrt((p**2).sum(1))
    cyto=(rr<=1)&(rr>qtest)
    s=np.sqrt(p[cyto,0]**2+p[cyto,1]**2)
    print(f"q={qtest}: closed form {frac_in_mask(qtest):.4f}  Monte-Carlo {np.mean(s<qtest):.4f}")

# ---- erythroblast stage geometry (cell and nuclear diameters, um; standard morphology) ----
stages=[("proerythroblast",18,12),("basophilic erythroblast",14,10),
        ("polychromatophilic erythroblast",11,8),("orthochromatic erythroblast",9,7),
        ("orthochromatic, maximally condensed",8,6.6)]
rows=[]
for nm,dc,dn in stages:
    q=dn/dc
    F=frac_in_mask(q); i,o,ratio=per_area(q)
    rows.append(dict(stage=nm, cell_diam_um=dc, nuc_diam_um=dn, nuc_cell_diam_ratio=round(q,3),
                     nuclear_volume_fraction=round(q**3,3),
                     pct_cytoplasmic_signal_inside_nuclear_mask=round(100*F,1),
                     per_pixel_intensity_ratio_nuc_over_cyto=round(ratio,2)))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== Projection model: how much signal from a PURELY CYTOPLASMIC protein lands in the nuclear mask ===")
print(T.to_string(index=False))
T.to_csv("ahsp_IFC_projection_model.csv",index=False)

q=np.linspace(0.05,0.97,400)
F=np.array([frac_in_mask(x) for x in q])
ratio=np.array([per_area(x)[2] for x in q])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax[0].plot(q,100*F,lw=2.5,color="#4C78A8")
ax[0].axhline(50,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[0].text(0.07,52,"50% of signal",fontsize=8)
for _,r_ in T.iterrows():
    ax[0].plot(r_.nuc_cell_diam_ratio, r_.pct_cytoplasmic_signal_inside_nuclear_mask,'o',ms=8,color="#E45756")
    ax[0].annotate(r_.stage.split()[0], (r_.nuc_cell_diam_ratio, r_.pct_cytoplasmic_signal_inside_nuclear_mask),
                   textcoords="offset points", xytext=(-6,9), fontsize=7.5, ha="right")
ax[0].set_xlabel("nuclear / cell diameter ratio"); ax[0].set_ylabel("% of cytoplasmic signal inside nuclear mask")
ax[0].set_title("A. A protein with ZERO nuclear content still projects\nmore than half its signal into the nuclear mask in late erythroblasts",fontsize=10)
ax[1].plot(q,ratio,lw=2.5,color="#54A24B"); ax[1].axhline(1,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax[1].set_xlabel("nuclear / cell diameter ratio"); ax[1].set_ylabel("mean intensity in mask / outside mask")
ax[1].set_title("B. Per-unit-area intensity ratio for the same purely\ncytoplasmic protein (1.0 = no apparent enrichment)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- AlphaFold retry (v4 404) ----
for v in ["v4","v3","v2"]:
    af=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9NZD4-F1-model_{v}.pdb",timeout=40)
    print(f"AlphaFold {v}: HTTP {af.status_code}")
    if af.status_code==200:
        pl={int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in af.text.split("\n")
            if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}
        s=pd.Series(pl)
        print(f"   mean pLDDT {s.mean():.1f}; n<50 = {(s<50).sum()}; n<70 = {(s<70).sum()} of {len(s)}")
        print("   lowest:", s.nsmallest(6).round(1).to_dict())
        break
